content.title: TC Biopharm launches cost reduction initiatives
content.summary: TC BioPharm (TCBP) announced initiatives to outsource several functions, moving to a more decentralized model, resulting in reduction in its workforce. The initiatives focus on moving to a CDMO model for production to accommodate larger production demand for future clinical trials, allowing TCB to review alternatives for new manufacturing facilities incorporating newly developed automated and other cell therapy production technologies.
